criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: KJG/TBIRD 2014 final detailed-plan set is titled for 225 Northwestern Avenue, matching the operator identity North by Northwest at this address. Sheet A105 directly dimensions first-floor shell at 18.4912 x 46.1899 m; the reopened model's ground shell is 18.4912 x 46.1899 m (differences +0.0000, +0.0000 m). A100 site plan labels the proposed five-story building on the parcel. The official building-footprint query has no target polygon, so the plan—not GIS—is the best available footprint evidence.
criteria.finding: Footprint dimensions and address identity are strongly supported by the proposed plan set. The plan is not an as-built or boundary survey; current model uses a rectangular envelope where A100/A105 show small recesses/chamfers, and no direct as-built wall polygon was found.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Reopened structural core center is [464.173, -213.286] m in campus coordinates and its long axis is north-south, matching A100's site-plan/north-arrow relationship. Against the raw 225 Northwestern parcel transformed with the documented local approximation, sampled plan-shell edge fractions inside parcel are [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0]; only corner statuses [True, True, True, True]. Geocoder address point candidate distances to the model center: [3.357, 43.269, 21.009] m.
criteria.finding: Placement is plausible and aligns with the address parcel/site drawing, but the address point is not a surveyed building center and the generalized parcel is not a footprint. The saved prior alignment comparison flags a north corner about 0.3 m beyond the parcel under its conversion; applying the AGENT.md conversion in this review puts all four corners and sampled edges just inside. This small transform-sensitive discrepancy means wall registration remains approximate.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The reopened ground plinth runs to 17.1391 m; upper mass ends at the plan's truss bearing near 17.1386 m; A100 specifies 5 proposed stories and 64 ft (19.5072 m), equal to the model's peak. A200/A201 elevations show a pitched shingle roof with raised gable/dormer elements; the model contains 6 raised gable sections and 2 end gable faces. Floor-level structure follows the printed elevations through 14.3859 m.
criteria.finding: Floor elevations, truss bearing, and overall design height are dimensioned in the 2014 proposed drawings, but later revisions/as-built conditions are not established. Model's roof planes and gable placement simplify A200/A201's more articulated roof; no as-built roof survey exists.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: A200/A201 directly support brick and siding fields, cast-stone/limestone bands and base, repeated residential windows, balconies, ground storefront/garage bays, awnings, and raised gable roof features. The model has 512 window objects, 40 balcony slabs, 20 ground-glazing objects, and 3 awning objects. Current exterior/end renders show these major visual categories and distinguish the broad ground level from residential stories.
criteria.finding: The model's facade is a simplified architectural reading rather than a close elevation trace: the plans show alternating brick and siding zones and more specific entry/storefront divisions, while the render reads largely as uniform brick, repetitive windows and simplified dormers. Bay spacing, some openings, balcony locations and awning locations remain approximate.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Direct Blender reopen found the stable collection Asset_massing_granite_student_living_3732ce0 with 1088 objects, 1088 meshes, and no external linked libraries or unpacked image files. Audit includes the official plan PDF, rendered sheets A100/A105/A200/A201, source register, raw parcel and geocoder snapshots, orthophoto, measurement/alignment checks, validation and two renders. Preview-only camera/lights are outside the exported collection.
criteria.finding: Export and procedural materials are portable. The 2014 plans are proposed-design evidence rather than post-construction record drawings, and the image tile's exact acquisition date and some facade source photography are not documented as dimensioned/as-built evidence.

findings: PASS: score is at or above 8/10. Dimensioned 2014 plans add direct design evidence for footprint, five floors, facade arrangement and roof form that was unavailable to the prior 6.0/10 review.
Source plan caveat: the 2014 sheets are proposed/final detailed plans, not verified as-built drawings; post-construction changes remain possible.

Site caveat: the address parcel/geocoder support placement but do not establish wall registration; the prior alignment file flags an approximately 0.3 m corner residual under its transform, while this review's AGENT.md conversion places all corners and sampled edges inside. The discrepancy is transform-sensitive, and the building-footprint query returned no matching target polygon.

Remaining modeling discrepancies: shell is simplified to a rectangular core, facade siding/entry/storefront pattern is coarser than A200/A201, and roof intersections/gable locations are simplified. Exact opening/balcony stationing remains interpreted.
